name: Aeon
description: Run and manage your Aeon autonomous agent from chat: list and run skills, follow runs and read their output, search the agent's memory, edit its strategy and voice, install skill packs and change settings. Aeon is an open-source autonomous agent that runs skills on a schedule with GitHub Actions in your own repo. Sign in with GitHub (OAuth 2.1) and choose which agent the client may use; writes commit to your own repo and secrets are never readable over MCP.
author: Aaron Elijah Mars
